ValidationRule.description: Discounts exceeding 10% cannot be applied to confirmed, completed, or billed appointments without Approved approval status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Discount_Percent__c)), Discount_Percent__c > 0.10, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Approval_Status__c, 'Approved')), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Confirmed'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'No Show'), Amount_Paid__c > 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Discounts exceeding 10% require an approved discount request before the appointment can be confirmed or billed.
